notes.title: In Other Waters 70% off in the Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/9be3c54c6da66ff6c54bf584b0b23e0d69c6ced4.png[/img]

[h3]The annual Fellow Traveller [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023]Publisher Sale[/url] is now on - and to celebrate, In Other Waters is 70% off! [/h3]

But that's not all, Jump Over the Age's latest game, [b]Citizen Sleeper[/b] is also currently [b]40%[/b] off!

Pick it up here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578650/Citizen_Sleeper/

With 3 DLC episodes waiting for you and a sequel on the way in Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector, now's the perfect time to play this beloved tabletop-inspired narrative RPG.

And finally, don't forget to [b]wishlist Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector[/b] to stay in the loop!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442460/Citizen_Sleeper_2_Starward_Vector/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023][b]➡️ Take me to the Publisher Sale ⬅️[/b][/url]

There are plenty more Fellow Traveller titles on sale to choose from - so whether you're looking for something new, a bargain, some cool soundtracks and bundles, or even something to play on Steam Deck, we're sure to have something just for you.

[h3]We're also thrilled to announce that three new games are joining the Fellow Traveller family; [b]Scrabdackle[/b], [b]Wander Stars[/b] and [b]Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo[/b] - read up on each of them below![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967820/40c1797b8a73e5d9ffe2140b51ffa845f73fec0e.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1575810/Wander_Stars/]Wander Stars[/url]:[/b] Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578720/Scrabdackle/]Scrabdackle[/url]:[/b] As a novice wizard, discover the intricate world of Scrabdackle and experience the impact wizardkind has unknowingly had upon it. Scrabdackle is a hand-drawn, non-linear adventure with a vast, intricate overworld, tight and responsive combat, cheeky banter, and pages of lore to discover.
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2246470/Kulebra_and_the_Souls_of_Limbo/]Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo[/url]:[/b] A 3D adventure where you play as Kulebra, a dead snake with a heart of gold that wakes up in Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.[/list]So get exploring and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023]grab some great narrative games[/url]!

Jump Over the Age has also announced their latest game, Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector. Wishlist it below to keep up to date on all the latest news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2442460/Citizen_Sleeper_2_Starward_Vector/

notes.title: Language Update: Japanese & Simplified Chinese
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/19dd585618e0cdaeb614588a3fc58c6e20b3006c.png[/img]

We're excited to announce that In Other Waters is now available in Japanese and Simplified Chinese!

Dive into Gliese 677Cc and explore the ocean with 33% off on Steam for the Autumn Sale 🐠

[previewyoutube=HkbZctn4DPo;full][/previewyoutube]
You are an Artificial Intelligence guiding a stranded xenobiologist through a beautiful and mysterious alien ocean, rich with impossible life. Upon awakening from your dreamless sleep, you are called upon to explore and study the depths of this world. What will you discover together?

Patch note Changes:
[list]
[*] Localizations for Japanese and Simplified Chinese
[*] Fixed a bug where players were unable to enter the Anomaly
[*] Fixed a bug where samples could disappear when dragged in the Base
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/50697267d3d4b3af3aea4af867cec76433d4577c.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone's diligent and helpful reports and discussions! Version 1.0.4 includes fixes and changes to the following issues:

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]     [*] Fixed Propulsion System not working on certain nodes and not working when used too far away from a current.
     [*] Fixed Bloomfan Stem sample request not appearing.
     [*] Fixed Epilogue Credits triggering on all Base Levels.
     [*] Fixed trigger activation when loading into a lower level.
     [*] Fixed bottom right sample in sample analysis being un-draggable in gamepad mode
     [*] Fixed a rare bug where Ellery would not react to a certain discovery
     [*] Fixed a rare bug where the player could become stuck after getting the torch and visiting the East Reef
     [*] Minor text fixes[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]     [*] Removed ascent and descent nodes in Northern Current
     [*] Antenna text now reflects activation post-epilogue[/list]

As always, we'll continue to monitor your reports and discussions. Consider reporting bugs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/890720/discussions/0/2148721524011825877/]here in our reporting thread. [/url]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/f17590a8dfe766eaaa0310f3752ffc12a229a33d.png[/img]

Thank you everyone for your bug reports and discussions. Version 1.0.3 includes fixes for all logged major issues, and many minor ones as well! See below for patch notes:

[b]Fixes:[/b][list]
     [*] Fixed rare bug where samples were consumed when clicked-on.
     [*] Fixed nodes not unlocking when propulsion system was activated outside of their range.
     [*] Fixed "Rift Cave" node getting occasionally blocked when nearby stalks extend.
     [*] Fixed Taxonomy sketch tab locking orders and kingdoms in taxa.
     [*] Minor text fixes
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b][list]
     [*] Gamepad button prompts can no longer be turned off until tutorial is complete.
     [*] Ellery now offers additional help for players struggling with first sampling attempt.
     [*] Ellery now gives more guidance on using soothespores.
     [*] Arcology no longer requires players to visit lower levels to be considered "discovered".
[/list]

Remember that if you encounter any issues, we're here to help! Consider reporting the details [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/890720/discussions/0/2148721524011825877/]here in our bug thread. [/url]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed rare bug where samples were consumed when clicked-on.
[*] Fixed nodes not unlocking when propulsion system was activated outside of their range.
[*] Fixed "Rift Cave" node getting occasionally blocked when nearby stalks extend.
[*] Fixed Taxonomy sketch tab locking orders and kingdoms in taxa.
